metadata.source: FAA LGA approach/departure plates and AirNav KLGA runway data (see each feature's own `source` property)
metadata.approximate_note: Approach volumes model a 3-degree glidepath-based ceiling/floor split along a modeled width; see each feature's own approximate_note. Rwy 4/13 departure corridors are this project's own placeholder, not an FAA-published departure procedure.

properties.name: LGA Rwy 22 final, 0-1 nm from threshold
properties.source: COPTER ILS/LOC RWY 22 plate (https://aeronav.faa.gov/d-tpp/2609/00289copteril22.pdf); threshold coords/true heading AirNav KLGA
properties.approximate_note: Centerline is the straight final from the sourced runway-22 threshold on its sourced true heading (212). Width (+-0.5 nm) and the 3-degree glidepath-based ceiling/floor split are modeled, not taken from the plate's protection surfaces.

properties.name: LGA Rwy 31 final/visual segment, RW31-DCTRK
properties.source: RNAV (GPS) X RWY 31 plate (https://aeronav.faa.gov/d-tpp/2610/00289rx31.pdf); fix positions FAA CIFP cycle 2610 (effective 2026-10-01) (https://aeronav.faa.gov/Upload_313-d/cifp/CIFP_261001.zip); threshold AirNav KLGA
properties.approximate_note: Models the curved visual segment (DRRYL-KEYTH-DCTRK-RW31) as straight TF legs between the CIFP fix positions, as the plate codes it; the flown track rounds the corners. Width (+-0.4 nm) and 3-degree glidepath floor/ceiling are modeled, not plate protection surfaces.

properties.name: LGA Rwy 4 departure corridor (modeled straight-out, 5 nm)
properties.source: Runway true heading from AirNav KLGA runway table; straight-out departure modeling is this project's own simplification, not an FAA-published departure procedure
properties.approximate_note: FAA does not publish a single departure centerline comparable to an approach final; this is a geofence placeholder on the runway heading, flagged approximate. Real departure headings/turns (e.g. Triborough/Throgs Neck routing) are only in the VATSIM SOP, marked [UNVERIFIED] in SPEC.md and not used here.

properties.name: Class B floor over the Hudson River Exclusion
properties.source: 14 CFR 93.350(d) (https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-14/chapter-I/subchapter-F/part-93/subpart-W): Hudson Exclusion up to the Class B floor; NY Class B Area K floor 1,300 ft MSL per FR Doc 2026-15552 (https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/07/31/2026-15552/amendment-of-class-b-airspace-new-york-ny)
properties.approximate_note: Same footprint as the Hudson SFRA corridor polygon (approximate shoreline digitization); represents Class B airspace starting at 1,300 ft MSL and above over that footprint.
